projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard project that includes: (1) data processing from customer CSV files, (2) log analysis from application logs, and (3) visualization components. Goal is to structure major milestones into manageable tasks with no task being too complex to execute.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Project Foundation & Data Infrastructure
tasks.details: Establish the technical foundation for the analytics dashboard: repository scaffolding, data storage strategy, schema definitions, and shared configuration. Everything built during this milestone is a prerequisite for the CSV processing, log analysis, and visualization milestones.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Build an ingestion and transformation pipeline for customer CSV files: file discovery, schema validation, cleaning/normalization, and loading into the analytics store, with data quality checks and error reporting.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Build log ingestion, parsing, and aggregation for application logs: parsing structured/unstructured log formats, extracting metrics (error rates, latency, traffic), and exposing aggregated results for the dashboard.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components & Dashboard
tasks.details: Design and implement the dashboard: layout, chart/table component library, wiring to the data API, filters, and user experience polish. Depends on the data and metrics exposed by Milestones 2 and 3.

tasks.name: Milestone 5: Integration, Testing & Release Readiness
tasks.details: End-to-end integration of pipeline, log analytics, and dashboard; automated tests; performance validation; documentation and deployment runbook. Final milestone before release.

tasks.name: Initialize repository, toolchain and project scaffolding
tasks.details: Create the repo, language/runtime toolchain, dependency management, linter/formatter config, and directory layout for pipeline/, analytics/, dashboard/, and tests/.

tasks.name: Define data storage architecture and canonical schemas
tasks.details: Select the analytics store (e.g. Postgres + columnar/Parquet layer), document table/dataset layout, naming conventions, and the canonical customer + event/log schemas that downstream milestones build against.

tasks.name: Set up configuration management and secret handling
tasks.details: Central config loader for environments (dev/staging/prod), env-var conventions, and secure secret storage approach for data source credentials. No secrets committed to the repo.

tasks.name: Document the API contract between data layer and dashboard
tasks.details: Define REST/GraphQL endpoint shapes, query parameters (date ranges, filters, granularity), response envelopes, pagination and error models so pipeline, log analytics and UI teams can work in parallel.

tasks.name: Set up CI pipeline and code quality gates
tasks.details: Add automated build, lint, type-check and test stages to CI, plus coverage thresholds and PR checks. Keep it fast (target under 5 minutes) and cacheable.

tasks.name: Create synthetic sample datasets for development
tasks.details: Generate privacy-safe synthetic customer CSVs (including messy edge cases: missing values, duplicate rows, bad dates) and sample application log files so the pipeline and dashboard can be developed before real data access.

tasks.name: Specify customer CSV schema and validation rules
tasks.details: Document expected columns, types, required fields, allowed value ranges and referential rules per CSV variant. Produce a machine-readable schema (JSON Schema/Pandera-style) to be enforced by the validator.

tasks.name: Implement CSV file discovery and ingestion
tasks.details: Locate new/changed CSV files in the configured source location, handle encoding/delimiter detection, checksum to avoid re-processing, and emit a manifest of files picked up per run.

tasks.name: Implement schema validation with row-level reject handling
tasks.details: Apply the defined schema to each batch, collect invalid rows into a quarantined rejects output with reason codes, and continue processing valid rows rather than failing the whole file.

tasks.name: Implement cleaning and normalization transforms
tasks.details: Trim whitespace, normalize casing, parse dates to ISO-8601 UTC, standardize country/phone formats, deduplicate records by stable business key, and mask/tokenize PII fields per the privacy policy.

tasks.name: Implement idempotent load into the analytics store
tasks.details: Upsert cleaned records into the canonical customer tables using the business key, in bounded batches, with run-level transactional guarantees so a failed run can be safely retried.

tasks.name: Build data quality checks and run summary report
tasks.details: Compute per-run metrics: rows read/accepted/rejected, null rates, duplicate counts, and freshness. Write a structured run summary plus human-readable report and alert on threshold breaches.

tasks.name: Unit-test CSV pipeline stages
tasks.details: Table-driven tests for parser, validator, transforms and loader using synthetic fixtures, covering messy rows, encoding issues and duplicate handling. Target 85%+ coverage of pipeline modules.

tasks.name: Inventory log sources and formats; define parse specification
tasks.details: Catalog each application log source (access, app, error), sample its format, and document field mappings to the canonical event schema including timestamp, level, service, trace id and latency.

tasks.name: Implement log ingestion and rotation handling
tasks.details: Read log files/directories incrementally, track byte offsets to resume after rotation, handle gzip archives, and record ingestion watermarks per source.

tasks.name: Implement structured and pattern-based log parsers
tasks.details: Build a JSON log parser plus regex/token-template parsers for plain-text lines, with graceful fallback for unparsed lines and a counter for parse failures by source.

tasks.name: Extract core log metrics (errors, latency, traffic)
tasks.details: Derive per-event metrics: severity classification, HTTP status buckets, request latency from paired start/end entries, and distinct-user/traffic counters.

tasks.name: Implement time-window aggregation queries
tasks.details: Aggregate metrics into hourly/daily rollups (error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, request volume) stored in summary tables for fast dashboard reads.

tasks.name: Group and rank error signatures
tasks.details: Normalize error messages into signatures (strip ids/timestamps), count occurrences per window, and surface top-N new or spiking error groups for the dashboard.

tasks.name: Unit-test log parsers and aggregation logic
tasks.details: Fixture-based tests for each log format, malformed-line handling, latency pairing and rollup math (including window boundary and percentile cases).

tasks.name: Produce dashboard wireframes and layout spec
tasks.details: Low-fidelity wireframes for the main dashboard pages (customer overview, log health), defining information hierarchy, KPI placement, and navigation. Reviewed with stakeholders before build.

tasks.name: Scaffold component library and theming
tasks.details: Set up the frontend app shell, charting library, design tokens (color palette, typography, spacing) and a Storybook-style preview environment for components.

tasks.name: Build KPI cards and chart components
tasks.details: Implement reusable KPI tile, line/area time-series chart, bar chart and sparkline components with consistent number formatting, tooltips and legends.

tasks.name: Build sortable data table and filter controls
tasks.details: Implement a virtualized sortable/paginated table for detail views plus reusable filter controls (date range picker, segment/customer filter, severity filter) that write to the shared query state.

tasks.name: Wire dashboard components to the data API
tasks.details: Connect components to the documented endpoints using a typed data client, with query caching, stale-while-revalidate, and URL-synced filter state.

tasks.name: Implement loading, error and empty states
tasks.details: Add skeletons, retryable error banners, partial-data indicators and explanatory empty states for every dashboard block so the UI degrades gracefully.

tasks.name: Accessibility and responsive layout pass
tasks.details: Keyboard navigation, ARIA labeling, color-contrast fixes, and responsive breakpoints for tablet/mobile. Validate with an automated a11y audit.

tasks.name: Build end-to-end integration test harness
tasks.details: Containerized test environment that seeds sample CSVs and logs, runs both pipelines, starts the API and exercises dashboard queries end to end.

tasks.name: Write E2E tests for critical user journeys
tasks.details: Automated browser tests for the top journeys: filter by date range, drill into a customer, inspect error trends, and export a report. Include visual-regression snapshots.

tasks.name: Validate performance and query latency budgets
tasks.details: Benchmark pipeline throughput on realistic volumes and dashboard query latency (target p95 under 2s). Document bottlenecks and apply index/rollup tuning.

tasks.name: Complete security and data-privacy review
tasks.details: Verify PII handling, access controls, secret management, dependency vulnerability scan and least-privilege database roles. Record findings and remediations.

tasks.name: Write user and operator documentation
tasks.details: End-user guide for dashboard navigation and filters, plus operator runbook covering pipeline scheduling, failure recovery and data-refresh troubleshooting.

tasks.name: Prepare deployment runbook and release checklist
tasks.details: Environment provisioning steps, rollout/rollback procedure, smoke-test checklist and sign-off criteria for the first production release.

tasks.name: Validate field types and required values
tasks.details: Apply the machine-readable schema row by row: type checks, required fields, allowed ranges/enums. Return a per-row error list as data (no exceptions thrown).

tasks.name: Write rejected rows to quarantine
tasks.details: Persist invalid rows to a rejects output with source file, row number and failing rule code. Valid rows continue downstream unaffected.

tasks.name: Classify severity and status buckets
tasks.details: Map log levels and HTTP status codes to normalized severity values and 2xx/3xx/4xx/5xx buckets as a pure, unit-testable function.

tasks.name: Compute latency and traffic counters
tasks.details: Pair request start/end entries by trace id to derive latency, and count distinct users plus raw request volume per interval.

tasks.name: Normalize text fields and parse dates
tasks.details: Trim whitespace, case-fold, parse dates to ISO-8601 UTC, and standardize country codes and phone number formats.

tasks.name: Deduplicate records by business key
tasks.details: Collapse duplicate customer records using deterministic precedence (most recent updated_at wins) and record counts of dropped duplicates.
